canonical_core.metric_eligibility: Only explicit required real-gold metrics in the canonical 10-document subset: revenue, operating_cash_flow, net_debt.
canonical_core.pass_fail_semantics: Fail on regression in metric/context/trust checks under the canonical tuple; do not expand metrics opportunistically.
canonical_core.trust_semantics: Use existing real-gold trust outcomes: trusted, abstain, quarantine. Trust must remain separate from breadth.
canonical_core.coverage_semantics: Coverage claim is limited to 10 docs and 24 required checks. It is not production extraction coverage.
canonical_core.recommended_acceptance_language: canonical_core passed; this is a no-regression result for the strict canonical subset only.

expanded_required.purpose: Current required-metric subset across the larger/evolving real-gold corpus.
expanded_required.metric_eligibility: Same supported required metrics as real-gold scorer: revenue, operating_cash_flow, net_debt across all current real-gold fixtures.
expanded_required.pass_fail_semantics: Use as stability testing over all current required labels; failures are required-subset regressions, not broad production coverage failures.
expanded_required.trust_semantics: Same real-gold trust model as canonical_core, but profile must be named expanded_required.
expanded_required.coverage_semantics: Coverage claim is limited to 15 docs and 39 required checks in the current corpus.
expanded_required.recommended_acceptance_language: expanded_required passed for the current required-metric subset; it does not measure all schema-supported or production-relevant metrics.

confirmed_metric_coverage.purpose: Production-relevant breadth over confirmed, source-evidenced, schema-supported metrics.
confirmed_metric_coverage.metric_eligibility: Score only metrics with source_status/source evidence, schema support, and non-ambiguous definition. Candidate, ambiguous, unsupported, and DATA_MISSING rows remain inventory rows, not failures.
confirmed_metric_coverage.pass_fail_semantics: Report coverage misses separately from trust failures. Extractor wrong/missing is a coverage miss only for eligible confirmed rows.
confirmed_metric_coverage.trust_semantics: Does not mutate canonical trust semantics and should not be mixed into canonical_core trust pass/fail.
confirmed_metric_coverage.coverage_semantics: Reports eligible, scored, candidate, ambiguous, unsupported, DATA_MISSING, correct, wrong, missing, abstain, quarantine counts independently.
confirmed_metric_coverage.recommended_acceptance_language: confirmed_metric_coverage reports breadth over confirmed schema-supported evidence. Candidate, ambiguous, unsupported, and DATA_MISSING rows are disclosed separately and are not silently counted as extractor failures.

tier_policy.Tier 1: revenue, operating_cash_flow, and explicit net_debt remain eligible for hard scoring where source evidence and schema support exist.
tier_policy.Tier 2: NPAT/profit attributable, EBIT, capex, cash_end/cash, total debt, EPS, shares outstanding, and free cash flow require explicit source evidence and schema/definition agreement before hard scoring.
tier_policy.Tier 3: Margins, ratios, adjusted/underlying metrics, segment metrics, derived net debt, growth rates, and peer-relative metrics stay out of hard scoring until definitions and source evidence are approved.

reporting_guardrails: Never use canonical_core to claim broad production extraction coverage.
Always name the scorecard profile beside any accuracy value.
Separate no-regression, required-subset stability, confirmed coverage, and trust semantics.
Do not count unsupported, ambiguous, or DATA_MISSING rows as extractor failures unless schema/evidence supports the metric.
